segment.source: Renders a boxed list of the sections of the page it sits on, each entry jumping straight to its heading. Use it for: the top of a long guide, a report with numbered chapters, a policy page with many parts, a documentation page before the first section. Prefer 'Outline Rail' when the contents should follow the reader down the page, and 'Jump List' for a bare inline run of links with no box around it.
